one_month_reasoning: Q3 2026 earnings fall inside the window: Reddit reported Q3 2025 on 30 Oct 2025 and Q2 2026 on 30 Jul 2026, so Q3 2026 is very likely around 28-30 Oct 2026 (exact date not yet confirmed in sources I could reach). Guidance is rev $860-870M (+47-49%) and adj. EBITDA $385-395M. Reddit has beaten revenue guidance by a wide margin every quarter, but the stock fell 12-21% after Q2 anyway because US DAUq fell from 53.5M to 53.2M. So the reaction depends on user and traffic numbers more than on revenue. A second US DAUq decline, or soft Q4 guidance pointing to deceleration toward ~35-40%, would add to the bear case. A US DAUq rebound could produce a squeeze from a depressed base. I take no directional view, so I centre the distribution on today's price ($151.69) with a slight downward tilt in the median from volatility drag. I widen sigma to ~21% for the month (20% normal monthly vol from 70%/3.5, plus earnings-gap risk).

fair_value.method: 60% P/E: haircut CY2027 EPS $6.35 x 22x (peer median 19.2x plus a modest growth premium) = ~$140, then +11% roll-forward toward 2028 earnings = $155. 40% FCF yield: haircut CY2027 FCF $1.70B at a 5.5% yield + ~$3.0B net cash / 207M shares = $164. Blend ~$157.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: CY2027 EPS consensus $7.07 haircut 10% to $6.35 x 22x = $140, rolled forward one year at ~11% to $155

inputs_detail.derivation: US DAUq fell sequentially (53.5M Q1 to 53.2M Q2), Google AI Overviews are cutting referral clicks, and Q3 guidance already implies deceleration from 61% to 48%. Consensus 2027 revenue +32% ($4.46B) assumes no logged-out traffic shock. I haircut to roughly the low-mid of the estimate range.

Peer median CY27 P/E is 19.2x (range 8.2x-41.5x across 9 peers). I add a ~15% premium for EPS growth of ~30% vs a peer median of ~16%, which is evidenced by Q2 2026 margin expansion (adj. EBITDA margin 43%, net cash $2.8B). The premium is capped because Reddit's traffic depends on a third party (Google) that the peers mostly do not have. 22x sits inside the peer range.

By Oct 2027 the market prices 2028 EPS. I assume ~20-25% EPS growth in 2028 (decelerating from the ~31% consensus for 2027), weight it about half for the NTM overlap, and round down for skeptic caution.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: CY2027 FCF ~$1.70B (38% of $4.46B revenue) / 5.5% yield = $30.9B + ~$3.0B net cash = $33.9B / 207M fully diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Q2 2026 FCF $261M on $805M = 32%, Q1 2026 47%. I take the mid-point and shade it down because FCF is flattered by stock comp.
Peer CY27 P/E median of ~19x implies an earnings yield of ~5%. I add a risk premium for traffic concentration and a short public track record.
$2.786B at 30 Jun 2026; buybacks of $235M per quarter absorb most FCF, so I add only a little.

bear.story: Google AI Overviews and Meta Forum erode logged-out and casual traffic, and US DAUq declines for several quarters. 2027 revenue growth slows to ~20% and EPS lands near $5.50. The stock rerates to the ad-tech/social trough multiples that PINS and TTD trade at (8-14x), say ~16-17x.

base.story: Growth decelerates in an orderly way from 61% to ~30% in 2027 with stable US users. Margins reach mid-40s EBITDA and EPS is ~$6.5-7. The multiple stays around 22x on near-term EPS, with roll-forward.

bull.story: International DAU growth (+28%) and ad pricing keep growth at 35%+, data licensing is renegotiated higher, and US users re-accelerate. EPS beats $8 on 2028 run-rate and the stock rerates toward 30x.

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: RDDT trades at 21.5x CY2027 consensus GAAP EPS ($151.69/$7.07), slightly above the 19.2x median. I use 22x on haircut EPS, which is inside the range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: A small premium is backed by structurally faster growth (Q3 guide +48%, 2027 revenue consensus +32% vs a peer median of ~20%), a 43% adj. Peer EPS comes from mixed GAAP/adjusted bases (PINS and TTD adjusted), which inflates their apparent cheapness relative to RDDT's GAAP basis.

thesis_break_reason: $108 is ~10% below the 52-week low ($119.27) and about 15x consensus 2027 GAAP EPS. Trading there would mean the market expects a structural traffic loss (Google AI Overviews / a data-licensing break, or sustained US DAUq declines) rather than ordinary 70%-vol noise. A recovery would then need US user growth to resume.

reasoning: Facts: Q2 2026 revenue was $805M (+61%), net income $253M, adj. EBITDA margin 43%, FCF $261M, cash $2.79B with no debt, 207M fully diluted shares, buybacks of $235M per quarter. Q3 guidance is +47-49%. Consensus CY27 GAAP EPS is $7.07 and revenue $4.46B. At $151.69 the stock is ~21.5x CY27 EPS. Bear evidence from the skeptic lane: (1) US DAUq fell sequentially and the stock dropped ~21% despite a $73M beat, which shows the narrative hinges on US users. (2) Reddit and publishers report AI Overviews cutting Google referral traffic, and Reddit has considered blocking Google, which puts at risk both traffic and the ~$60M/yr licensing deal. (3) Meta launched Forum, a Reddit clone. (4) Downgrades (Wells Fargo $143, Roth $145, Wall Street Zen to Hold) cite user growth. (5) The CEO sells steadily under 10b5-1, which is small relative to holdings and not a red flag. (6) The ad-peer group has derated hard (PINS ~8x, TTD ~12x CY27). I found no short-seller report, debt, covenant or accounting red flag. The balance sheet is clean, and the bear case is about growth durability and multiple, not solvency. Weighing it honestly: fundamentals are very strong and the stock has already de-rated ~40% from its high, so the skeptic case mostly argues against a full rerate to the $210-218 sell-side median rather than for a collapse. Fair value is ~$157 (P/E 22x on haircut EPS, rolled forward, plus an FCF-yield check). Distribution: a bear/base/bull lognormal mixture (25%/50%/25% at $95/$158/$240 with 25-35% dispersion) gives a median of ~$155, mean ~$164, and an effective vol of ~50%, below the 70% realized because the business is now profitable and well-capitalised. Research was limited: Twelve Data and Alpha Vantage were paywalled or rate-limited, Zacks blocked fetching, and peer forward EV/EBITDA could not be sourced consistently. Peer EPS is CY2027 Yahoo-style consensus on one calendar-year basis, though some peers report adjusted rather than GAAP EPS.
